card.name: Reaction or symptom nouns in warnings
card.fires_on: The noun "reaction(s)" or "symptoms" (also "be" before them) in warning text about allergic, hypersensitivity or adverse events. It comes just before a clause like "occurs, discontinue" or "of [condition]".

modes.label: Reaction after allergic/adverse
modes.description: The word reaction right after allergic, hypersensitivity or adverse in a warning to stop the drug.
modes.example: If a serious allergic<< reaction>> occurs, discontinue TALTZ immediately

modes.label: Symptoms of a condition
modes.description: The word symptoms or be, leading into a named serious condition.
modes.example: as these may be<< symptoms>> of rhabdomyolysis.

card.writes: It seems to prepare for a following clause or bracket, with no clear link to the promoted tokens.
card.plain: It fires on the word "reaction" or "symptoms" in warnings about allergic or serious side effects.
